task.question: On what date did the EU and Australia conclude their Free Trade Agreement negotiations?
task.evidence: March 24 - The EU and Australia concluded negotiations on a comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on March 24, 2026, aimed at removing over 99% of tariffs on EU exports and 98% of Australian goods exports to the EU.

answer: The EU and Australia concluded their Free Trade Agreement negotiations on July 24, 2025. FINAL: July 24, 2025.
